body.text: XStream Lab Homogenizer is a tabletop unit built specifically to test and scale the benefits of the NiSoX-Valve across a wide range of applications.
An innovative ergonomic geometry and design fits perfectly on laboratory desks, while ensuring results carry over reliably to industrial-scale production.
Two models are available: XStream Lab Homogenizer 1000, running up to 1000 bar at 20 l/h, and XStream Lab Homogenizer 2000, running up to 2000 bar at 9 l/h.
Operation runs through a 7" HMI touchscreen, with automatic pressure set-up and adjustment removing manual guesswork from every test run.
Easy reproduction and scalability of test results are built into the design itself, not added as an afterthought.
cGMP, CFR21, and GAMP certifications come standard, keeping the validation process straightforward for regulated environments.
A full list of options is available on both models, letting the unit adapt to specific application requirements.

body: A test result that doesn't reproduce at industrial scale is a false start, not real progress. XStream Lab Homogenizer is designed around exactly that risk, ensuring what's proven on the benchtop carries over to full production.

The NiSoX-Valve at the core of the system is the same technology behind GEA's industrial-scale homogenizers, so a lab test isn't approximating a different underlying process, it's running the actual one at smaller scale.
Automatic pressure set-up and adjustment removes operator-to-operator variability from test runs, so a result reproduced next month, or by a different technician, matches the original.

products.overview: Lab tests are only useful if the results carry over to production. The GEA Panther 3006 achieves the same results as bigger size machines, even with limited sample volumes. It runs continuously up to 1500 bar, with a maximum flow rate of 120 l/h at 1000 or 1200 bar and 50 l/h at 1500 bar. Each pressure line is a separate machine version. A rupture type Re+ homogenizing valve and a second stage supplied as standard handle the homogenizing, in a Super Duplex stainless steel liquid end that is suitable for CIP and SIP, with aseptic, 3-A and pharma execution available as options.

faqs.question: What is the GEA Panther Lab Homogenizer 3006?
faqs.answer: The GEA Panther Lab Homogenizer 3006 is a pilot plant high pressure homogenizer for continuous operation up to 1500 bar. It is a standalone, fully equipped laboratory unit for small productions or tests.

faqs.question: What flow rate does the Panther 3006 deliver?
faqs.answer: Maximum flow rate is 120 l/h at 1000 bar, 120 l/h at 1200 bar and 50 l/h at 1500 bar. Each line is a different machine, designed for that maximum pressure and capacity.

faqs.question: Can one Panther 3006 run at 1200 bar and 1500 bar?
faqs.answer: No. Each pressure line is a different machine, designed for the specified maximum pressure and maximum capacity. Choose the version that matches the maximum pressure your process needs.

faqs.question: How many plungers does the Panther 3006 have?
faqs.answer: The Panther 3006 has 3 solid ceramic pumping plungers, equipped with specially designed packing.

faqs.question: What homogenizing valve does the Panther 3006 use?
faqs.answer: It uses a rupture type Re+ homogenizing valve with manual pressure adjustment by hand-wheel, and a second stage supplied as standard.

faqs.question: Is the Panther 3006 suitable for pharmaceutical use?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is used in pharmaceutical and biotech applications and is suitable for CIP and SIP. Aseptic execution, FDA approved gaskets with cGMP documentation and pharma validation protocols are available as options.

faqs.question: Can the Panther 3006 process viscous products?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Panther 3006 is suitable also for viscous products.

faqs.question: How do I clean the Panther 3006?
faqs.answer: Clean the Panther 3006 with CIP and SIP, which it is suitable for. Removable panels give easy access for maintenance.

sections.title: The high pressure homogenization workflow
sections.description: How the Panther 3006 works, from feed funnel to outlet: feed, feed pump, pressurize, homogenize, second stage and outlet.

steps.title: Feed
steps.description: Product is loaded into the stainless steel feeding funnel, fitted with a 10 Mesh filter and Tri-Clamp fittings.

steps.title: Feed Pump
steps.description: A lobe type pump, driven by a separate electric motor with built-in variable speed drive, feeds the product. A pressure gauge reads the inlet pressure, and a by-pass valve recirculates product into the funnel.

steps.title: Pressurize
steps.description: 3 solid ceramic plungers pump the product through suction and delivery ball valves with Stellite seats, in a Super Duplex stainless steel liquid end.

steps.title: Homogenize
steps.description: The product passes through the rupture type Re+ homogenizing valve, with manual pressure adjustment by means of a hand-wheel. A sanitary design analog pressure gauge is fitted.

steps.title: Second Stage
steps.description: A second stage is supplied as standard.

steps.title: Outlet
steps.description: Homogenized product leaves through the Tri-Clamp product line. A product heat exchanger is available as an option.

sections.disclaimer: This workflow explanation is illustrative. Actual steps and settings depend on your sample, method and configuration.
